company.name: Origins AI Inc
company.one_liner: Enterprise AI platform for automating business workflows

title: Origins AI Inc: first look

claims.text: Describes itself as an enterprise AI platform for automating business workflows, which matches Accel's AI focus.
Sells an enterprise AI platform for chat, voice, retrieval and embedded AI, with agents that automate complex business processes.
Offers agentic automation that handles workflows like triage, approvals, monitoring and reporting, claiming it saves 1,000+ staff hours yearly.
Its Velocity AI Suite is described as an enterprise AI platform that can be deployed behind a customer's firewall.
Lists an AI-augmented engineering services business alongside its products, with claimed results of 2x faster releases and 30% lower dev costs.
Accel's listed themes include AI agents and agentic economy, which this company's agent products relate to.
Company is listed as based in the US, which fits Accel's Americas geography.
Accel's stated stage range includes early stage and seed/Series A, and the company was founded in 2025 with one funding round recorded.
The company's own site describes a large share of its work as AI consulting and engineering services, which may differ from a pure software platform.
The company's own site describes it as an engineering partner, with case studies for large clients such as Amazon and Samsung, so revenue mix is unclear.
The recorded funding is small, at 300000 USD in a single round dated 2025-10-23, so the company is at a very early stage.
Stage is unknown in the dataset, so it is unclear whether the company fits Accel's seed/Series A target.
Several of the company's headline results, such as 80% repeat business and 2x faster releases, are self-reported marketing claims.
The company is a crowded area: enterprise AI platforms and AI agents are common themes, so differentiation is not evidenced in the sources.
